description: This file defines abstract base classes and core concepts for model elements in the 'behave' testing framework, including statement classes with tagging and status management.

classes.name: BasicStatement
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a statement with location, keyword, name, and captured output.

classes.name: TagStatement
classes.description: Subclass of BasicStatement with tags and method to determine if it should run based on tags.

classes.name: TagAndStatusStatement
classes.description: Subclass of BasicStatement with tags, status, and methods to manage execution state and inheritance of tags.

classes.name: Replayable
classes.description: Class providing a replay method for formatting or re-executing statements.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing statement with location, keyword, name, and tags.

methods.name: should_run_with_tags
methods.description: Determines if the statement should run given a tag expression.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Property that computes and returns the current status of the statement.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the statement, with special handling for cleanup errors.

methods.name: compute_status
methods.description: Abstract method to compute the current status; to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: replay
methods.description: Replays the statement using a formatter.
